scripts.dev: bun run --filter @bluprint/shared build && bun run --parallel --filter '*' --if-present dev
scripts.build: bun run --filter @bluprint/shared build && bun run --filter './apps/*' --if-present build
scripts.test: bun run --filter @bluprint/shared build && bun run --filter '*' --if-present test
scripts.test:unit: bun run --filter @bluprint/shared build && bun run --filter '*' --if-present test:unit
scripts.test:int: bun run --filter @bluprint/shared build && bun run --filter '*' --if-present test:int
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @bluprint/shared build && bun run --filter '*' --if-present typecheck
